items.quote:
laid siege to Samaria.
25  There was a great famine in the city; the siege lasted so long that a donkey’s head sold for eighty shekels of silver
items.contrast: The army was besieging Samaria, not still assembling for the march.
items.reason: The price is presented as a result of the prolonged siege, which began after the army had mobilized and marched to Samaria.
